content:
**Route 61A** is a roadway in *Fallout 76*.

The roadway branches off of Highway 61 north of Morgantown, then runs on the eastern side of town, before terminating at the intersection with Highway 64, east of Vault-Tec University.

Branches off of Highway 61 near Grafton Dam. Runs the border of Morgantown to the east towards Fraternity Row.

Route 61A appears in *Fallout 76*.
